purpose: Render five explicit RIGHT TOC tab leaders as bounded vector decoration while preserving extracted text, pagination and graphics state.
limitations: Vector approximation relative to tab-run size/color; not font-exact Word glyph spacing.
CENTER/DECIMAL/BAR, multiple TOC tabs and automatic TOC update remain incomplete.
No new performance benchmark or complete PDF/UA/assistive-technology validation.
Native Word and Windows were not tested.

import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE
from docx.enum.text import WD_TAB_ALIGNMENT,WD_TAB_LEADER
from docx.shared import Pt
from aspose.words_foss.libreoffice import convert_to_pdf
import pymupdf
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-toc-leader-native');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);records={}
for leader in (1,2,3,4,5):
 doc=Document();s=doc.sections[0]
 s.page_width=Pt(300);s.page_height=Pt(180);s.left_margin=s.right_margin=s.top_margin=s.bottom_margin=Pt(20)
 p=doc.add_paragraph();p.style=doc.styles.add_style('TOC 1',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH)
 p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Pt(12);p.paragraph_format.right_indent=Pt(6)
 p.paragraph_format.tab_stops.add_tab_stop(Pt(180),WD_TAB_ALIGNMENT.RIGHT,WD_TAB_LEADER(leader))
 p.add_run('TITLE').font.size=Pt(12);p.add_run('\t123').font.size=Pt(16)
 source=root/f'{leader}.docx';doc.save(source);out=source.with_suffix('.pdf');convert_to_pdf(source,out)
 with pymupdf.open(out) as pdf:
  pix=pdf[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(3,3));pix.save(root/f'{leader}.png')
  records[str(leader)]={'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'text':pdf[0].get_text(),'words':pdf[0].get_text('words'),'pixel_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pix.samples).hexdigest()}
Path('/tmp/docweave-native-leaders.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
print('five native leader documents rendered')

results={}
for location in ('body','header','footer'):
 for kind in ('toc','gap'):
  for columns in (1,2):
   for shaping in (False,True):
    model=ns['split_line_model'](kind,columns,location)
    options=aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions();options.text_shaping=shaping
    raw=ns['LdmPdfWriter'](options).write_to_bytes(model)

     assert len(pdf)==1
